title: Fix Fast DDS consumer metadata and release iros2j 1.0.3

estimates.basis: Corrective packaging release with one prior full iros2j release sample and uncertainty in the complete source-built Fast DDS contract.

Audit identified a bounded omission: source-built Fast DDS 2.14.6 and Fast CDR 2.2.7 prefixes were excluded from the Debian inventory, causing rmw packages to resolve Debian Fast DDS 3.1.2 development metadata.

operations.evidence: v2.1.0.2 APT SHA-256 44415440f02e0d77c2dad6ad8bff520c24918e6304e78028ea905ac58bbd60c7; package inventory and Packages metadata
operations.summary: Verified that rmw_fastrtps packages depend on Debian libfastrtps-dev/libfastcdr-dev while the pinned source-built plain-CMake prefixes are absent from the package inventory.

errors.symptom: The first corrective native gate built, audited, installed, and configured the clean Fast DDS consumer, then ros2 topic pub --once timed out with exit 124 while waiting for a matching subscriber.
errors.root_cause: ros2 topic pub defaults to waiting for one matching subscription when --once is used; the gate intended to validate publisher initialization without requiring a separate subscriber.
errors.correction: Set --wait-matching-subscriptions 0 for the bounded standalone Fast DDS publisher smoke.
errors.prevention: Regression-test the explicit no-subscriber discovery-wait contract in verify-native.sh.

reusable_improvements: Inventory source-built plain-CMake dependencies and build a clean downstream consumer in release verification.
